scope: Benchmark relevance: qrels-positive versus all other dense100 documents. Unannotated documents are treated as zero, not asserted truly irrelevant. All pairs use fixed dense ranking; top10_touch includes either document in dense top10, top10_crossing includes exactly one. Rank ties follow TREC ordering. Undefined zero-denominator query ratios excluded and eligible counts reported. Query-bootstrap conditional on trained single-seed models.
